title: Seamless Ricotta Ravioli
steps: Mix ricotta, lemon zest, basil, salt and pepper. Taste and adjust seasoning, then stir in the egg yolks.
Sift enough semolina into a sheet pan to make a ¼-inch layer. Portion the filling into 16 g balls and place on the flour.
Sift more semolina over the balls to bury them. Refrigerate for about 36–48 hours, until a flour shell forms and the ravioli can be lifted with a spoon.
Lift each raviolo out with a slotted spoon; gently turn it over and brush excess flour from the bottom.
Lower the ravioli gently into unsalted, low-simmering water. Cook about 1 minute, until formed and cooked. Lift out with a slotted spoon and divide among 4 plates. Serve with sauce of your choice.
headnote: Allow 36–48 hours of refrigerated resting. Adapted from ChefSteps.
